critical_meanings: Mathlib orthogonalGroup is the real-trivial-star unitaryGroup alias; the actual real O is definitionally usable as unitary(Matrix ... R). specialOrthogonalGroup is a distinct determinant-one subtype and is not used.
unitary carries star(U)*U=1 and U*star(U)=1; real star is trivial entrywise, so matrix star is transpose. Both determinant signs are permitted.
Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply is literally U*B*star(U). The DJE parent is determinant-only for arbitrary real square B, with no PosDef, eigenvalue or determinant certificate input.
DJE internally applies determinant multiplicativity and the unitary identity to get det(U)*det(star U)=1. No det U=1 premise is used.
Matrix.det is the alternating/Leibniz determinant. Matrix.det_diagonal is the genuine full finite-product theorem, not a supplied spectral characterization.

Mathlib multivariateGaussian is the existing standard-Gaussian covariance-square-root pushforward. Existing admissibility makes the actual precision positive definite; GPD proves the inverse covariance is positive definite and avoids the non-PSD degenerate fallback.
The canonical density leaf uses volume on EuclideanSpace, not Gaussian probability as a reference. It proves the real exponent d/2 from rpow_natCast/sqrt/rpow multiplication, including odd dimension.

The Test keeps the actual same A in covariance and exponent; only its determinant coefficient becomes the fixed grid product. PosDef is constructed internally by the existing actual admissibility theorem.
